hook: 47 unread DMs. Every one was a booking.
cta_sub: AI that answers every DM and books the appointment

beats.say: I just opened Instagram. Forty seven unread messages.
How much is Botox. Do you have openings Saturday. Can I book for my sister.
Half of them are from last week. They've definitely gone somewhere else by now.
Jess, every one of those messages was a booking. They just needed a fast answer.
I'm Jarvis. People decide fast. Research on lead response shows the odds of qualifying a lead drop sharply after the first five minutes.
I'm with clients all day. I can't answer in five minutes.
You don't have to. I answer every DM and text in under a minute, explain your pricing the way you'd explain it, and send them your open slots.
And if they're nervous? A lot of first timers are.
I tell them their first visit starts with a free consult, so nothing happens until they're comfortable. Then I book it, and send a reminder the day before.
So Saturday fills up while I'm working.
Saturday filled up an hour ago. Three new clients, and the sister too.
Okay, you're officially my favorite employee.
If your DMs are full of bookings you never get to, DM the word BUILD, and Jarvis Works will set me up for your spa.
